headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: June 5, 2026**
article:
The Philadelphia Phillies edged out the San Diego Padres 6-4 in a thrilling matchup, with Zack Wheeler pitching a strong 7.0 innings for the Phillies. The Baltimore Orioles secured a dominant 8-2 victory over the Boston Red Sox, with Willson Contreras leading the Orioles' offense with a 2-hit, 1-home run performance. The New York Yankees took down the Cleveland Guardians 2-1, securing a crucial win in their latest matchup.

Several key players are dealing with injuries, impacting their teams' lineups. Ryan Fernandez, a right-hander for the St. Louis Cardinals, has been placed on the 15-day injured list due to low back pain. The Boston Red Sox have also been affected, with Garrett Crochet transferred to the 60-day injured list due to left shoulder inflammation. Other teams have also suffered injuries, including the New York Yankees, Kansas City Royals, Boston Red Sox, Atlanta Braves, Toronto Blue Jays, Los Angeles Angels.

The Boston Red Sox have added to their roster with the acquisition of left-handed pitcher Joe La Sorsa, who was traded to the Red Sox from the Pittsburgh Pirates. The Cincinnati Reds traded RHP Kyle Nicolas to the Baltimore Orioles for cash, while the Los Angeles Angels traded C Austin Wynns to the Atlanta Braves for cash. The Minnesota Twins traded RHP Simeon Woods Richardson to the Toronto Blue Jays for cash, and the Pittsburgh Pirates traded RHP Justin Lawrence to the Minnesota Twins for cash.

top_news.title: **Padres Fall to Phillies in Thrilling Matchup**
top_news.summary: The Philadelphia Phillies edged out the San Diego Padres 6-4, securing a crucial win. Jackson Merrill led the Padres' offense with a home run and two RBIs, while Zack Wheeler pitched a strong 7.0 innings for the Phillies, striking out 8 and allowing 2 earned runs.

top_news.title: **Orioles Take Down Red Sox 8-2**
top_news.summary: The Baltimore Orioles secured a dominant 8-2 victory over the Boston Red Sox, with Trevor Rogers earning the win. Willson Contreras led the Orioles' offense with a 2-hit, 1-home run performance, including a 12th homer of the season on a fly ball to left field.

top_news.title: **Yankees Take Down Guardians in Thrilling Matchup**
top_news.summary: The New York Yankees edged out the Cleveland Guardians 2-1, securing a crucial win in their latest matchup. Brent Headrick earned the win for the Yankees, while David Bednar secured the save.

top_news.title: **Giants Take Down Brewers in Thrilling 12-9 Victory**
top_news.summary: The San Francisco Giants outlasted the Milwaukee Brewers in a high-scoring matchup, securing a 12-9 win. Jackson Chourio led the Brewers' offense with 3 hits, 2 home runs, and 4 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Cardinals' Ryan Fernandez Lands on Injured List**
top_news.summary: St. Louis Cardinals right-hander Ryan Fernandez has been placed on the 15-day injured list due to low back pain, effective retroactive to June 3, 2026.

top_news.title: **Red Sox Acquire Left-Handed Pitcher in Trade**
top_news.summary: The Boston Red Sox have added to their roster with the acquisition of left-handed pitcher Joe La Sorsa, who was traded to the Red Sox from the Pittsburgh Pirates.
